content.text: Please do these two steps in order and track them with your todo/plan tool: (1) create a file named hello.txt containing exactly the line: hello (2) in app.js rename the function greet to sayHello, including its export. Keep your final reply to one short sentence.
I’ll track the two requested steps in order, inspect the files, then make and verify both edits.

update.name: exec_command
update.title: if [ -e hello.txt ]; then od -An -tx1c hello.txt; fi

rawInput.command: if [ -e hello.txt ]; then od -An -tx1c hello.txt; fi

update.name: exec_command
update.title: pwd && rg --files -g 'app.js' -g '!node_modules' && if [ -f app.js ]; then sed -n '1,160p' app.js; fi

rawInput.command: pwd && rg --files -g 'app.js' -g '!node_modules' && if [ -f app.js ]; then sed -n '1,160p' app.js; fi

terminal_output.data:
<tmp>/repos/codex-bundled
app.js
function greet(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}

module.exports = { greet };

content.text: The repository has the expected `app.js`, and `hello.txt` does not exist. I’m completing step 1 first, then I’ll rename the function and export.

update.name: exec_command
update.title: test "$(cat hello.txt)" = hello && ! rg '\bgreet\b' app.js && rg 'sayHello|module.exports' app.js && git diff -- app.js hello.txt

rawInput.command: test "$(cat hello.txt)" = hello && ! rg '\bgreet\b' app.js && rg 'sayHello|module.exports' app.js && git diff -- app.js hello.txt

content.text: Created `hello.txt` with `hello` and renamed `greet` to `sayHello` in `app.js`, including its export.
